# Hikari no Matsuri 2027 (HNM Vol. 3)

> Hikari no Matsuri (光の祭り 2027) is the premier single-day Japanese language, Anime, and Cultural festival in South India, hosted on January 8, 2027 at Chennai Institute of Technology (CIT) in collaboration with Isshoni Nihongo (一緒に日本語).

## Core Event Information
- **Event Name**: Hikari no Matsuri 2027 (HNM Vol. 3) / 光の祭り 2027
- **Date**: Friday, January 8, 2027
- **Time**: 09:00 AM – 08:30 PM IST (Full single-day festival)
- **Venue**: Chennai Institute of Technology (CIT) Campus Grounds, Sarathy Nagar, Kundrathur, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600069, India
- **Organizers**: Lumos (Student Community of CIT) in collaboration with Isshoni Nihongo (Japanese Language & Culture Club)
- **Official Website**: https://hnm3.vercel.app/
- **Previous Edition**: https://hnmvol2.com/
- **Expected Attendance**: 5,000+ anime enthusiasts, cosplayers, Japanese learners, and students

## Ticket Tiers & Passes
Passes can be booked online via the official portal with Razorpay checkout:
1. **Student Pass** — ₹99
   - Access to general matsuri grounds, cultural pavilions, exhibition zones, and Bon Odori finale.
2. **General Otaku Pass** — ₹150
   - Full festival access, Anisong live stage viewing, gaming arcade access, and commemorative wristband.
3. **VIP Matsuri Pass** — ₹175
   - Priority stage seating for Anisong concert & Cosplay Masquerade, exclusive VIP badge, fast-track entry to Yatai food street and Maid Cafe, and Japanese calligraphy souvenir.

## Event Schedule (January 8, 2027)
- **09:30 AM**: Grand Inauguration & Japanese Delegate Address (Main Stage)
- **10:30 AM**: Notes of Nippon: Traditional Koto & Shamisen Instrumental Ensemble (Acoustic Stage)
- **11:30 AM**: Akihabara no Quest: Anime Trivia & Gaming Arena Tournament (Esports Arena)
- **01:00 PM**: Shodo (Calligraphy) & Origami Masterclasses (Cultural Pavilion)
- **02:30 PM**: Cosplay Masquerade & Runway Championship (Main Stage)
- **04:30 PM**: Anime Quiz Bowl & Voice Acting Live Showdown (Auditorium Stage)
- **06:00 PM**: J-Rock & Anisong Live Extravaganza with The Tokyo Echoes (Main Stage)
- **07:30 PM**: Lantern Lighting Ceremony & Bon Odori Community Dance (Matsuri Courtyard)

## Key Festival Highlights
- **Cosplay Masquerade**: National cosplay competition with ₹50,000+ prize pool evaluated on craft, accuracy, and stage presence.
- **Yatai Food Street**: Authentic Japanese street delicacies including Takoyaki, Ramen, Yakitori, Taiyaki, Dango, and Onigiri.
- **Cultural Pavilions**: Hands-on Yukata draping, Tea Ceremony (Chado), Shodo calligraphy, and Nihon Dive immersion booths.
- **Isshoni Nihongo Club**: CIT's student club dedicated to JLPT (N5–N1) coaching, Japanese conversational fluency, cultural exchanges, and study-in-Japan career pathways.
